description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); Close; ADO (Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) runs CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V MEMO WITH COMPRESSION) and closes. A shared DAO session inserts ID 1 with V of 1908 ASCII 'a' characters (would be FF FE + 1908 = 1910 bytes if compressed, 3816 bytes if uncompressed) through a table recordset (AddNew/Update) and closes. Page 0 bytes 3584-3591, page 1 and pages 42-53 are read after create and after insert (pages 0-55 hashed after insert), and FieldSize read back. Asks whether ACE compresses the Memo value and whether it is stored inline, as a single LVAL row, or chained.
retentionNote: r-q22-lv-open: R-FMT-2 long-value open cases (ACE 2007 ACCDB)
